extracted.name: Zucchini Herb Casserole
extracted.description: Celebrate summer with this quick casserole made with zucchini, herbs, cheese, and rice.
ingredient_lines: 0.33333334326744 cup uncooked long grain white rice
2 cups shredded sharp Cheddar cheese, divided
instruction_lines: Combine rice and water in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 20 minutes, until rice is tender.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a shallow 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.

Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat, and cook the zucchini, green onions, and garlic 5 minutes, or until tender. Season with garlic salt, basil, paprika, and oregano. Mix in the cooked rice, tomatoes, and 1 cup cheese. Continue to cook and stir until heated through. Transfer to the prepared casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven, uncovered, until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 20 minutes.
